safety_verdicts.content: Patient to have a review in 24-48 hours if symptoms are not improving.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated follow-up/safety-netting does not include the 24–48 hour review timeframe if not improving.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the specific 24–48 hour review timeframe can delay reassessment of potentially worsening abdominal pain/possible UTI with hematuria, increasing the chance of missed progression to pyelonephritis, sepsis, or an alternative urgent diagnosis. While safety-netting to return if worse was present, loss of a clear early follow-up instruction reduces timely escalation if symptoms simply fail to improve.
